terra.problem: The claim that the Levites have no territory of their own comes from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not establish that no Levite cities will be near Jericho. It locates Moses across from Jericho but does not rule that area out for the cities.
Saying the trial comes before anybody takes action goes beyond the text. The manslayer has already fled to a city of refuge.
The wording is not the same: verse 12 says the manslayer stands trial before the assembly, while verse 24 says the congregation must judge.
Saying hostility matters, not the object, generalizes beyond this example. The preceding cases specify objects without stating hostility.
The passage does not say the assembly hands the murderer over to the avenger of blood.
The quotation uses “I,” but the LORD is not identified as the speaker before the quotation.
